content: Ub Ana Oroubon
Iban maiye Jesu harew Galilee sisibinamaim ana bai’ubaiyen bai tit. Sabuw i himour kwanekwan imih i wa afe’en yen mare naatu sabuw harew sisibin dones yan himarir
naatu i oroubonamaim sawar moumurih na’in i’obaiyih eo.
“Kwananowar! Masaw bowayan ana masawamaim ub tanumamih in.
Naatu ana ub tata’asi’asiy ana maramaim ub afa i ef yan hira’iy, naatu mamu hina hibow hi’aa.
Ub afa i karakarar yan kamar men gagamin yanamaim hira’iy, naatu saisewat hikuboubunih hiyen, anayabin me kikimin baban inu’in.
Imih veya yen rararan ana mar ana fora’abinamaim, nati ub hikukubounih i hi’arat himorob, anayabin ah wairoron i men ra’iy me babanika.
Ub afa i fotan kokor wanawanan hira’iy, naatu ro’oh men matar, anayabin fotan yen fafa rab isuk.
Baise ub afa i me gewasin yan hira’iy, naatu hikubounih hiyen hibiw, afa i magamagar 30 na’atube, afa i rubirubih 60 na’atube, naatu afa i hiwai re 100 na’atube.”
Naatu Jesu iuwih eo, “O yait tain nama’am na’at iti tur nanowar ininotanot.”
Jesu akisin ma’am ana maramaim ana bai’ufununayah nah 12 naatu sabuw afa iyab tur hinonowar hina hibatiy oroubon anayabin so’ob isan.
Naatu iuwih, “God ana aiwob ana buriburin i hibai kwa hit. Baise iyab no ufunamaim tema’am sawar etei i boro oroubonamaim hina’uwih.
Saise,

content.text: Baise tur hinanowar hai yawas hinabobotabir

content: Naatu Jesu i’uwih, “Kwa iti oroubon naniyan men kwanabaib na’at oroubon afa auman naniyah boro mi’itube kwanaso’ob?
Masaw bowayan i God ana tur ub na’atube ta’asiy re.
Sabuw afa i ub ef yan ta’asi’asiyen hire’erebe, God ana tur tenonowar ufunamaim, Satan boro nan abisa re hai yawasamaim tatanum boro nabosair.
Afa i ub karakarar yanamaim hire’erebe, tur gewasin tenonowar ana veya i boro matah nakabiy ereyasisir auman hinab.
Baise i an wairoroh en, imih boro men maninaka nawainabih, anayabin tur gewasin hibaib isan ahay waf naatu bai’akir kakafin wanawanan hinarur ana maramaim i boro saisewat hinare.
Naatu baise ub afa i fotan kokor wanawanan hire’erebe, i tur gewasin tenonowar,
baise i hai yababan biyah ana yasisir isan, totobuyoy ana baitenbibiren, naatu hai kok sawar ta ta men gewasih erun, tur gewasin hai yawasamaim erabirab, imih men ebiwamih.
Naatu sabuw afa i ub me gewasin yanamaim hire’ere’ebe, tur hinowar hibasit hibai naatu hai yawasamaim ro’on matar, afa i 30, afa 60, naatu afa i 100.”
Ramef Ana Efan
Naatu i’uwih, “Kwa ramef kwabito’ab i noukwatamaim kwatatarafut? O gem babanamaim kwaya’iyai? Ai ana sisikofamaim kwasisikof?
Anayabin sawar abisa baibunuwenamaim ti’inu’in boro hinagatur, naatu sawar abisa wa’iwa’irih ti’inu’in boro hinatit hinibebeyan.
O yait tain nama’am na’at iti tur inanowar inanot!”
Ibanak iuwih maiye, “Kwananowar gewas! O sabuw kufufufunih na’atube, nati fufun ta’imonamaim boro God o nafufuni, baise boro afe’enamaim naya’abar auman nafufuni.
Yait aurin ema’am boro afe’en hinaya’abar hinitin, yait aurin en, abistanawat biyan ti’inu’in boro hinabosair.”
Ibanak eo maiye, “God ana aiwob i orot ub me yan tatanum na’atube.
Fai mar in emimisir, i men so’ob ub i mi’itube kuboun yen erara’at.
Me akisin ub ituw eyey, wantoro’ot i boro nakufufun, naatu naiwan nayai, imaibo boro niw ro’on namatar.
Naatu sanabey ibiyamur ana maramaim, masaw bowayan boro ana nikok nab natit nan natar.”
Momor Ro’on
Naatu ibanak eo maiye, “God ana aiwob boro abisa’amaim tanayai tanao, o oroubon boro menatanamaim tanakubuna kwananowar?
I ana itinin i momor ro’on kikimin maiyow na’atube, tafaramamaim iti ro’on i kikimin maiyow o boro me yan inatanum.
Baise inatatanun ufunamaim, boro nara’at nayen masaw etei nanatabir, ai gagamin famefamen auman namatar, naatu famenamaim mamu boro hinan hinabatar.”
Oroubon maumurih na’in iti na’atube imaim binan sabuw hima hinowar, saife isah tirerereb naniyan hitab.
Sabuw isah i oroubonamaim eo hinonowar, baise nabinamaim oroubon hai yabih i ana bai’ufununayah eo hinonowar.
Jesu Wowog Eotan Nuwarob Eafuw
Nati veya ta’imon ana rabirab, i ana bai’ufununayah iuwih, “It i boro tanarabon harew rounane.”
Ana bai’ufununayah hire wa i afe’en ma’amamaim hisra’at. Naatu wa afa i nati’imaim auman hibatabat.
Hirarabon wowog tafair tit, naatu yabat misir, harew wa wanawanan iwan yen awan kakaratan.
Jesu wa uranane ukwarin kunuwar yara’ah matan fot inu’in. Ana bai’ufununayah hibunibun misir hiu, “Bai’obaiyenayan it morob isan men kunotanot?”
Misir wowog naatu yabat kwarar eo, “Kwanutanub! Kwa’inbaibinub!” Naatu wowog morob ra’iy nuwarob eafuw.
Ana bai’ufununayah iuwih, “Aisim kwabirubir? Kwa men kwabitumatum?”
Ana bai’ufununayah hibir naatu taiyuwih hibabatiyih, “Iti orot i yait? Wowog naatu yabat hairi fanan hibai!”
